paragraphs: Every month, the same story: a call home to ask about the bill, then waiting, never sure if it arrived.

<accent>Qareeb</accent> changes that. From anywhere in the world, pay your family’s phone, internet, electricity and water bills in Syria, and top up their Syriatel and MTN credit. All <accent>in one tap</accent>. See every detail before you pay, and know the moment it arrives.
closing: Because being far shouldn’t mean being distant.
